first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, and memory_31 and memory_86 both show that signup simplification and shortened onboarding drive durable activation gains in self-serve SMB accounts. Verifying memory_31 (the foundational signup simplification result) and memory_73 (to confirm pricing isn't the primary lever here, since we're facing competitive pricing pressure but the activation/onboarding declines suggest product-side friction) will clarify whether this is a reopenable lever. A standard experiment to simplify onboarding targets the measurable drop in completion rates directly, addresses the QoQ trend reversal, and preserves sustainable revenue quality by improving time-to-value rather than competing on price or burning cash on incentives. This protects against the competitor's aggressive pricing while improving our core conversion funnel.
